en: Dacia, year 101. Rome is now the second biggest problem.
Hits things with a sword. Gets hit back. Wears it well.
Raises the dead to fight for you. They have not complained. Yet.
Arrows and Enter, or the mouse. Esc goes back.
No save yet. The past is unwritten.
Enemies lie down politely and think about what they did.
Physics and good taste both leave the room.
Changes are saved when you leave.
